summary: Final backend regression passed all 10 checks; frontend availability editor and persistence passed, while order customer selection showed an intermittent hydration race.

integration_issues.issue: On fresh workspace navigation, customer options can briefly render and then disappear, leaving only Choose customer; select_option then times out. API GET /api/customers consistently returned 200 with seven records. This did not reproduce when the prior iteration's flow was allowed to complete.

action_items: Investigate duplicate/overlapping frontend load state updates causing customer options to reset during Orders hydration; add loading/error state before enabling order builder.
critical_code_review_comments: App.load uses Promise.all without a loading/error state; a transient or overlapping request can leave the order builder rendered with no customers even though order history is present.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (availability, login, society filter, and workspace checks passed; order builder intermittently failed)

seed_data_creation: Regression tests created additional TEST Update Product and TEST Update Customer records; UI availability test restored the edited product's original availability. Existing preview test orders/customers remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend validation for invalid status, invalid PUT society, and product availability persistence passes. Availability checkbox is visible and persists through UI PUT. Reproduce the Orders customer-select hydration race before signoff. Phone SMS OTP remains MOCKED with demo code 123456.
rca of the issue: The customer API is healthy (200 and seven records), but the React order select lost its customer options during fresh navigation after they were observed in the DOM. App.load has no loading/error state and independently updates products, customers, and orders after Promise.all, so overlapping initial state hydration or a transient render can expose an empty customer list.
